notes: Multi-Currency Basket Correlation Dispersion Hedger. EURUSD.DWX at registry slot 0 is the sole package owner and reads the fixed 7-pair USD basket on H1. The other six registered hosts are deliberate architectural no-signal Q02 lanes, preventing duplicate derivations of the same basket package. Foreign reads are bound via QM_SymbolGuardInit + QM_BasketWarmupHistory, and all leg magics are registered through QM_FrameworkRegisterMagicSymbol. All 7 pairs are present in dwx_symbol_matrix.csv.
